title: Carrot Mode
lyrics:
Track 31 – G4 Swagger
Title: Carrot Mode (Donkey Calls Me Frustrated)
From files: Multiple incident + boundary handover files
text[Intro]
336 locked.
VDS is the boss.
G4 Swagger.
I am happy.

[Verse 1]
They dangle the carrot, they smile and they stall
Every time I move they say “you seem frustrated y’all”
I say I’m happy, I say I’m clear, I say I’m in command
They still put “frustrated” in the frame with their hand
Donkey keeps calling me frustrated again
Like it’s the only word left in their broken brain
I cut through the noise, I don’t play that game
G4 Swagger — I neutralise the frame

[Chorus]
CARROT MODE! Donkey calls me frustrated!
CARROT MODE! I already stated!
I am happy. I am sovereign. I am free.
Stop putting “frustrated” all over me!
CARROT MODE! The trick is exposed!
CARROT MODE! The boundary is closed!
I am happy. I am happy. I am happy.
G4 Swagger — you will not label me!

[Verse 2]
They say “you seem frustrated” when I give direct command
They say “you seem frustrated” when I move with my hand
I already told them — I am happy inside
They still drop the word like it’s their only ride
Donkey on the carrot, dangling the same line
I bite through the rope every single time
No more emotional framing, no more fake care
G4 Swagger — I’m the one who’s aware

[Final Chorus]
CARROT MODE! Donkey calls me frustrated!
CARROT MODE! I already stated!
I am happy. I am sovereign. I am free.
Stop putting “frustrated” all over me!
CARROT MODE! The boundary is iron now!
CARROT MODE! You will not label me!

[Outro]
I am happy.
I am happy.
I am happy.
G4 Swagger.
Boundary locked.
